project.objective: When and where did Inocente Lopez, born 11 June 1860 in Oratorio de Concepción, Cuscatlán, El Salvador, and married to Virginia Mendoza in 1885, die?

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: Plain language for someone who has never done genealogy. No identifiers, file names, tool names or field names. Never write GPS, proof, proved or exhaustive: say genealogy standards; call an answer a conclusion when it is well established and a finding otherwise; say what we searched and what we could not reach. Do not describe your own instructions or checks. Do not narrate between actions; report once when the step is done: what was found, in one paragraph, and what happens next in one sentence.

questions.question: When and where did Inocente Lopez, born 11 June 1860 in Oratorio de Concepción, Cuscatlán, El Salvador, and married to Virginia Mendoza in 1885, die?
questions.rationale: The tree records a Death fact for Inocente Lopez with no date or place. El Salvador civil registration (Registro Civil, 1704–2001) and parish records (registros parroquiales y diocesanos, 1655–1977) cover the likely death period and are already indexed on FamilySearch; children's records in those same collections frequently name a deceased father and give the death date, providing an additional avenue. This is the sole fact the objective seeks.
